source_title: What Is A Payment Account Reserve
snippet_primary: "When you have a Payment account reserve on your account, a percentage of your earnings on orders are set aside and your sales aren't available for deposit until 45 days have passed from the date of the sale."
subject_exact: Payment account reserve: percentage of order earnings set aside, unavailable for deposit until 45 days after the sale
